card.name: Opioid names in dose conversion text
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation just before an opioid drug name (oral, and, comma, from) in opioid dose-conversion tables and instructions. Also partway through opioid names like levorphanol.

modes.label: Before an opioid name
modes.description: A linking word or mark right before the next opioid is named in a conversion list.

modes.label: Inside opioid names
modes.description: Partway through a long opioid name or its tablet title.

modes.label: Before a morphine-equivalent figure
modes.description: The space before a number in oral morphine equivalents.
modes.example: greater than<< >>80 mg/day oral morphine equivalents
